Container.Name: shin-wallslice
Container.Overview: One wallpaper. Every device. Crop locally to six device presets, adjust framing and OLED shadows, then download PNGs or a ZIP. Optional AI is disabled by default. Single-user trusted-LAN access; no built-in login. Allow 4 GiB RAM and 4 GiB writable temporary disk space. Only preferences persist in appdata; uploaded images and exports expire. Startup initializes only /data and preferences.json, then Fastify runs as UID/GID 1000.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Dedicated preferences directory. Do not map a share root here.

Config.Name: Advanced: enable AI
Config.Description: Optional. Requires your vision service URL and model.
